Acceptance criteria:
- All existing tests pass (tiffImageTest, tiffExporterTest).
- Two-TU link test: two .cpp files each including TiffStdOut.hpp compile and link cleanly.
- Example runs on all fixtures including LONG-ImageWidth ones (pc260001.tif, dscf0013.tif, smallliz.tif).
- Malformed TIFF probes (ASCII count==0, rational denom 0, cyclic IFD, truncated strip) produce exceptions, not crashes or hangs.
- takeImage() leaves the exporter's buffer empty.
- README example compiles.

Research findings (verified by reading code):

DEFECT 1 (ODR): TiffImage.hpp non-inline free functions: `std::string version()` (~line 98), `readAt` (~333), `writeAt` (~368), `load` both overloads (~739, ~766). Fix: add `inline` to the five functions; wrap the six operators in `namespace TiffCraft { ... }` and add `inline`. Risk: ADL covers all existing call sites (all operand types are TiffCraft::*); doctest's portable path uses ADL; no `::operator<<` qualified uses in repo. No ambiguity once global ones are removed.

DEFECT 2 (crashers, TiffImage.hpp unless noted):
(a) ASCII entry count==0 → `Entry::read` ~line 564: `entry.values_[valueSize - 1]` with empty values_ → OOB. Fix: guard `valueSize > 0` (throw on zero-count ASCII or skip the NUL check).
(b) Rational denominator 0 → division by zero in `makeIntVec` in TiffExporter.hpp ~line 173 (`values[i].numerator / values[i].denominator`), reached via getIntVec/getInt. Fix: throw std::runtime_error on zero denominator inside the is_rational_v branch.
(c) Cyclic IFD offset → infinite loop in `TiffImage::read(std::istream&)` ~line 653-666 while loop over `nextIFDOffset`. Fix: keep a std::set<uint32_t> of visited offsets; throw on revisit (optionally validate offset >= 8 / even).
Verification: crafted malformed TIFFs must throw or produce empty result, never crash/hang (best under ASan/UBSan + timeout).

DEFECT 3 (truncated strips): `readAt` (TiffImage.hpp ~333-354) checks stream before read but never after `stream.read(...)`; callers (Entry::read, readImageStrips, readImageTiles) ignore return value; vectors are zero-initialized so short reads silently yield zeros. Fix: after read, check `!stream || gcount() != size` → throw std::runtime_error.

DEFECT 4 (takeImage copies): TiffExporter.hpp ~line 157: `[[nodiscard]] Image takeImage() const { return std::move(image_); }` — moving from const → copy. Fix: drop `const` (and optionally reset image_ to Image{}). Call sites: examples/tiff_exporter.cpp:47, apps/tiff_exporter.cpp:78, internal TiffExporterAny (TiffExporter.hpp:712) — all use non-const objects, so dropping const is fine.

DEFECT 5 (TiffExporterAny multi-IFD): TiffExporter.hpp class TiffExporterAny ~lines 639-719: member `bool exported_ = false;` set once in tryToExport (~706-714), never reset, so second+ IFDs never exported; image_ silently keeps first IFD; the `!exported_ || image_.dataSize() == 0` check at ~695 doesn't catch it. Fix options: set exported_=false at top of operator() per IFD (last-wins), or drop the member and use a local bool. Note tryToExport catches FormatNotSupportedError — zero-denominator guard should throw FormatNotSupportedError or plain runtime_error consistently; plain runtime_error propagates (good). Multi-IFD fixtures: dscf0013.tif and text.tif (2 IFDs each).

DEFECT 6 (example throws on LONG ImageWidth): examples/tiff_image.cpp lines ~57-62: `values<uint16_t>()` for ImageWidth AND ImageLength (issue names ImageWidth; ImageLength has the same bug). values<T>() throws unless sizeof(T)==typeBytes(type). pc260001.tif, dscf0013.tif, smallliz.tif all store both tags as LONG (type 4) → throws "Invalid type size for values span". Fix: type-agnostic read (e.g. dispatch on entry.type() via TiffCraft::dispatchType, or handle SHORT/LONG explicitly) for both width and length.

**File:** `include/tiffcraft/TiffExporter.hpp`
